objective: Add the earned-budget rule to SLOW-LOOP's slow loop, tune it on rand, block and local window 10 at n = 800 (E) and on rand and block alone (Erb), and test with five runs per instance on seven patterns at n = 3200 against re-tuned Novelty+ and probSAT, tuned static probing, the best fixed budget on the same mixture (Gm) and SLOW-LOOP's G and GO.
title: A productivity-driven slow budget for the structure-changing slow loop, tested on fresh instances and new meeting patterns
